bootstrap.detail: Deterministic synthetic Alice/Bob scene uses production Ed25519 and X25519 keys. Native certificates establish the five exact signatures, distinct devices/node keys and five-op distinctness; all five operations also validate through the production engine, with wrong-key/changed-message controls. An explicit Nat-indexed run starts at init and cycles ticks, approval and FIFO-head delivery. Kernel proofs establish Enabled, recurring ticks/approval, eventual delivery of every queued message, exact Run.Fair and no-drop Run.Ideal without using bootstrap. This cert applies bootstrap to that run. The infinite execution is the noncomputable bootstrap model, not an execution of the app or TCP.

FairExecution.fair.detail: Closed kernel proof for the concrete infinite run from the initial Alice/Bob bootstrap scene. The scheduler recurs through tickA, tickB, approval and FIFO-head delivery; finite-position progress proves every queued message is eventually delivered despite new arrivals, and no scheduled action drops messages. Fairness and ideality do not assume Scene.Good or any bootstrap conclusion. This run uses the noncomputable bootstrap model, not TCP.
